title: Normalization of the top-open comparison
statement: For any commutative square of schemes f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S, g':X'→X [def-pc-scheme], derived objects K,K' and φ:L(g')*K→K' [def-pc-derived-category], invertibility of the explicit comparison b_X for the top open [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison] implies invertibility of the original canonical composite Lg*Rf*K→Rf'*L(g')*K→Rf'*K' [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No cartesian, quasi-coherent, affine, stalk or finiteness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Apply the source-open unit-naturality identity at the top open.

The top-open immersion and its pullback projection are isomorphisms. The selected pullback composition comparisons and identity comparison exhibit pullback along each as fully faithful, so its adjunction unit is invertible. The mapped units and right-adjoint composition comparisons are therefore invertible. The unit-naturality identity makes the original comparison followed by an invertible factor invertible; cancellation gives the result. These arguments apply to arbitrary commutative squares and all derived objects.
